transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.subtitle: View and manage your transaction history

split.confirmMessage: The 2 transactions will become independent rows.

promoteSuggest.mergeAllIntro: {n} pairs become linked transactions. Where the two rows of a pair have a different description or different tags, keep:
promoteSuggest.mergeAllLeftHint: the description and tags of the first row of each pair, as the banner lists it
promoteSuggest.mergeAllRightHint: the description and tags of the second row of each pair
promoteSuggest.mergeAllCombineHint: both descriptions, and the tags of both rows

form.fxDatesHint: The 'From' and 'To' dates usually match: they differ when the broker credits the new currency on another day.

bulk.title: Transactions · {total} rows
bulk.confirmEditDeleteMessage: This transaction is marked for deletion. Do you want to restore it and edit it instead?
bulk.splitHint: To delete only one side, first use Split to unlink the pair.
bulk.dateSortHint: Date is primary. Pairs stay together, ordered by earliest leg date, then latest leg date and stable row ID.
bulk.balanceGroupOutsideWorkspace: No contributing rows from this workspace match this group. Check the broker's history.
bulk.workspaceRowHint: Position in the current sort. a/b are paired sides, not transaction IDs.
bulk.issueRowsHidden: The affected rows are hidden by the table filters.
bulk.unseenSuggestionsTitle: Suggestions you have not looked at
bulk.unseenSuggestionsMessage: {n, plural, one {# suggestion to merge two transactions has} other {# suggestions to merge two transactions have}} not been looked at yet. Merging the two halves of a transfer keeps them from counting as a separate deposit and withdrawal. Save anyway?

costBasisOverride.tooltip: Override of the weighted avg cost. If empty, auto-calculated from purchases at save. Override for Exit Tax, inheritance, or special fiscal rules. Use the Total/Per unit toggle below to choose how this amount is entered.
costBasisOverride.warningAdjustment: The manual cost basis is empty: the transaction cannot be saved without it. Enter what these shares cost: 0 for a stock split, the donor's original cost for a gift.

wacPreview.missingFx: Cannot calculate WAC: missing FX rate
wacPreview.docsTooltip: Learn how WAC (Weighted Average Cost) is calculated
wacPreview.validateHint: Complete the fields and validate to calculate WAC

wac.fxDisclaimer: The FX rate used may differ from the one applied by your broker. Verify the average cost with your broker.

promote.atomicWarning: This will DELETE both source rows and CREATE 2 linked rows atomically. On rollback nothing changes.

validate.autoOff: Auto-validate is OFF ({n} rows > {threshold}) — press ⚡️ Validate now before commit
validate.contextualIssuesHeader: With the other pending changes, this row causes the following issues:

errors.idRequired: Transaction ID is required and must be > 0
errors.cashRequired: {type} requires a cash amount and currency
errors.cashForbidden: {type} must not have a cash movement
errors.linkUuidRequired: {type} requires a link UUID for pairing
errors.fxConversionCashRequired: FX Conversion requires a non-zero cash amount
errors.eventRequiresAsset: Event link requires an asset to be selected
errors.eventTypeIncompatible: {type} cannot be linked to an asset event (only {allowed})
errors.balanceCashNegative: Saving would cause {currency} cash to go negative ({formattedBalance}) on {date} at {brokerName}
errors.balanceAssetNegative: Saving would cause {assetName} holdings to go negative ({balance}) on {date} at {brokerName}
errors.accessDenied: Access denied: EDITOR role required for {brokerName}
errors.pairTypeMismatch: Linked pair must share the same type (found {typeA} and {typeB})
errors.pairSameBroker: Transfer requires distinct brokers (both assigned to {brokerName})
errors.typeCannotSplit: This transaction type cannot be split
errors.splitIdsMismatch: The two transactions are not a linked pair
errors.promoteRefNotFound: Transaction referenced for promotion not found
errors.alreadyPaired: Transaction is already linked to another transaction
errors.noPromoteRule: No promotion rule matches these two transaction types
errors.costBasisRequired: ❌ {type} with positive quantity requires a cost basis. Use Auto mode (WAC) or enter a manual value.
errors.pairDeleteIncomplete: Linked transaction: deleting this row also requires deleting its pair (transaction #{partnerId}). If the pair belongs to a broker you cannot edit, ask its owner to delete it.
errors.pairQuantityMismatch: A transfer must move the same quantity out of one broker and into the other (found {qtyA} and {qtyB})
errors.pairAssetMismatch: Both sides of a transfer must be the same asset
errors.wacFxUnavailableSplit: The units that leave are valued at their average cost, which needs the {pairs} exchange rate: sync the FX rates, then split the pair again.
errors.pairBrokerMismatch: Both sides of a currency exchange must be on the same broker
errors.integerDigitsExceeded: At most {max} digits before the decimal point
errors.autoCostUnreadable: Automatic cost unavailable: {count, plural, one {# transaction used} other {# transactions used}} for this asset's average cost {count, plural, one {holds} other {hold}} a value that is not a number. Enter the cost by hand.
errors.ledgerUnreadable: The balances of {brokerName} can't be checked: {count, plural, one {# of its transactions holds} other {# of its transactions hold}} a value that is not a number. Ask the administrator to repair the data.

fieldErrors.quantityInvalid: Quantity must be a valid number
fieldErrors.cashRequired: Cash amount and currency are required
